title: Add audit event schema library + JSON Schema validator (v1 draft)
author: Hanae Suzuki
release_notes: Internal: introduce shared audit event types + schema validation utilities for consistent sensitive-action logging; no external behavior change by itself.
description: Summary: This PR introduces a shared audit event library in the monorepo to standardize emission of security audit logs across services. It adds (1) strongly-typed structs for AuditEvent v1 (draft) with consistent field naming, (2) a JSON Schema artifact + validator that runs at runtime (and in tests) to catch malformed events early, and (3) example producers + unit tests to demonstrate correct usage in the control-plane and API gateway. Motivation: We’ve had drift across services (missing actor fields, inconsistent correlation IDs, ad-hoc target naming), which makes downstream normalization/export and customer SIEM mapping brittle. This is the foundation for ENG-4822+ (event_type registry + lints) and the service-by-service instrumentation rollouts. Scope: Adds new package `pkg/auditlog` (types, helpers, schema); adds `schemas/audit/audit-event-v1.schema.json`; adds test utilities and golden fixtures; wires minimal examples in two services behind a feature flag. Non-goals: This does not attempt to fully enumerate sensitive actions or retrofit existing producers (tracked in follow-up PRs). Implementation details: - `pkg/auditlog/event.go`: `AuditEventV1` struct with required fields; `NewEvent()` helper enforces non-empty `event_id`, `event_type`, `occurred_at`, `tenant_id` and populates common context from request-scoped metadata where available. - `pkg/auditlog/validate.go`: `ValidateJSON([]byte) error` and `ValidateEvent(AuditEventV1) error` using embedded JSON Schema (go:embed) + compiled schema cache. Validation failures include a stable error code (`AUDIT_SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED`) and a truncated path (to avoid logging payloads). - `pkg/auditlog/redaction.go`: guards to prevent common secret/PII fields from being attached as raw values (best-effort denylist + length caps). - Examples: `services/control-plane/internal/audit/example_emitter.go` and `services/api-gateway/internal/audit/example_emitter.go` show creating and validating an event. These are currently invoked only in tests / dev-mode to avoid double-emission before the event registry lands. Example payload (shape only): `{ "schema_version":"1.0", "event_id":"01HS...", "event_type":"rbac.role.updated", "occurred_at":"2026-01-15T02:41:19.221Z", "tenant_id":"tnt_123", "actor_type":"user", "actor_id":"usr_456", "actor_display":"aisha@customer.com", "source_ip":"203.0.113.10", "request_id":"req_...", "trace_id":"00-...", "target_type":"role", "target_id":"role_admin", "action_result":"success" }`. Test plan: - Unit tests for schema validation across required/optional fields. - Golden tests for example producers (serialize -> validate -> snapshot compare). - Benchmark: schema compilation cached; validation per event stays <1ms in unit benchmark on dev laptop (see `BenchmarkValidateEventV1`). Rollout/compat: - This ships library-only; no existing producers are migrated in this PR. - Follow-ups will adopt `pkg/auditlog` and turn validation on in CI + selected runtime paths (with sampling to control overhead). Risks: - Validation overhead if enabled on hot paths; mitigated by cache + planned sampling. - Over-constraining schema too early; mitigated by namespaced extensions fields and schema versioning policy in follow-up docs. Notes for reviewers: Please focus on field naming consistency (actor/target semantics), error handling (do not leak payloads), and whether the helper API is ergonomic for service owners.
commits: auditlog: add AuditEventV1 struct + constructor helpers
auditlog: embed JSON schema + validator with compiled cache
auditlog: add redaction guards + length caps for free-form fields
tests: add fixtures + golden validation tests
examples: add control-plane + api-gateway example producers (test-only)
conversation: Allison Grant (review): Please make sure we’re not introducing any high-cardinality free-form strings that will explode dashboards. In particular, `actor_display` and `user_agent` need caps and guidance. Also, can we avoid logging raw request URLs by default? Hanae Suzuki (author): Good call. Added max length caps (256 for actor_display, 512 for user_agent) and updated README to recommend allow-listing user_agent parsing into low-cardinality fields. Removed `request_url` from the base struct; leaving it for a future namespaced extension if needed. Ethan Park (review): The `NewEventFromContext(ctx)` helper currently populates `tenant_id` from middleware, but some internal calls won’t have it. How do you want callers to behave? Also, please ensure validation errors don’t log the whole event. Hanae Suzuki (author): Updated helper to require explicit `tenant_id` for non-request contexts (constructor now takes `tenantID string`), and `ValidateEvent` returns structured errors with only schema path + code (no payload). Added test to ensure error string doesn’t include JSON. Kevin Osei (review): For downstream dedupe and SIEM retries, we should prefer ULID/UUID format guidance for `event_id`. Can we document it and add a generator helper? Hanae Suzuki (author): Added `GenerateEventID()` using ULID (monotonic entropy) and documented that event_id must be globally unique per emitted event; also noted exporter-side de-dupe is expected on `event_id` for at-least-once delivery. Sahana Iyer (review): Build is failing in CI due to go:embed path when running from Bazel sandbox. Can you switch to embedding via `//go:embed` with a stable relative path and add a Bazel data dependency? Hanae Suzuki (author): Fixed embed path to `schemas/audit/audit-event-v1.schema.json`, added Bazel `data` entry, and verified `bazel test //...` locally. Logan Wright (review): Can you add a tiny metric hook so producers can count validation failures without logging payloads? We’ll want that for coverage dashboards later. Hanae Suzuki (author): Added optional `ValidationObserver` interface (no-op by default) and an example of wiring it to a counter in tests; we can implement real metrics in follow-up PRs. Approvals: Allison Grant approved. Ethan Park approved. Kevin Osei approved. Sahana Iyer approved. Logan Wright approved. Merge: Squashed and merged after green CI.
